messages.author: 8dbb1a48db624e60
messages.subject: Regarding differential CpG analysis
parts:
Hi Altuna,

I was performing differential methylation analysis at base pair level using methylKitR. I am using two replicates per condition. It seems that the correlation between the replicates is lesser than across the replicates of other condition. Unfortunately, I am not getting any differential CpG in the end between the conditions using logistic regression model.
Should I pool the data of replicate and perform the analysis? Could you please let me know as per your experience.

Many thanks!
Shalu

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Regarding differential CpG analysis
parts:
You can pool them, but i would also check the quality of the different samples (sequencing quality and bisulfite conversion rate). If you can identify a quality issue you can drop some of the samples. 

Best,
Altuna
